title: CapybaraKV persistent list append
summary: ListTable::append specifies a journaled update to a CapybaraKV persistent list under table, journal, tentative-list, and permission-factory preconditions. Its contract preserves table and journal validity; success appends the new element and bounds journal mutation to the table range, while length and logical-range rejection preserve state and capacity.

source.statement: On the Ok(new_list_addr) result, the source postcondition is: final(self)@ == (ListTableView { tentative: Some(old(self)@.tentative.unwrap().append(list_addr, new_list_addr, new_element)), used_slots: final(self)@.used_slots, ..old(self)@ }).

assumptions: The method requires old(self).valid(old(journal)@); old(journal).valid(); old(self)@.tentative is Some; old(self)@.tentative.unwrap().m.contains_key(list_addr); perm_factory.id() == old(journal)@.powerpm_id; and old(self).perm_factory_permits_states_equivalent_for_me(old(journal)@, *perm_factory).
reuse: Use the exact pinned CapybaraKV source and Verus version compatible with its vstd pin. Establish the method preconditions for a valid ListTable and Journal, a present tentative list, and a permission factory matching the journal's powerpm_id; then use the success and error postconditions of ListTable::append. Its update is tied to ListTableSnapshot::append and the durable/modified append cases, with the list recovery mapping updated by ListRecoveryMapping::append. This is a source-indexed method in the CapybaraKV crate, not a standalone module.
